name: Chicken Shawarma
description: Juicy yogurt-marinated spiced chicken wrapped in soft flatbread with crisp vegetables and creamy garlic sauce.
method: Mix yogurt, lemon juice, oil, cumin, paprika, coriander, black pepper and salt. Coat the chicken and marinate covered in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
Heat a wide pan or grill pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in batches so it browns rather than steams.
Turn the pieces and continue cooking until browned and fully cooked through; chicken should reach 74°C/165°F in the thickest pieces.
Rest the chicken for a few minutes, then slice into smaller strips if needed.
Warm the flatbreads, add cabbage, cucumber and chicken, drizzle with garlic sauce, then roll tightly and serve immediately.
tips: Marinate chicken in the refrigerator, not at room temperature.
Avoid overcrowding the pan so the chicken develops browned edges.
storage: Refrigerate cooked chicken promptly for up to 2 days. Keep vegetables and sauce separate and assemble wraps just before serving.
